clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, Marla's Last Wish calls you to bring a husband and wife together in death. Novice Elreth asks you to find Samuel Fipps, still bound to the Scourge, so he can be buried beside his wife, Marla. The Forsaken seek to honor the ties they had in life and to set themselves apart from the Scourge.

Marla and Samuel Fipps were husband and wife in Lordaeron before the Third War devastated their home. When the plague swept through their lands, Samuel succumbed and rose as a mindless thrall of the Scourge. Marla escaped undeath, but not her husband. In his frenzy, Samuel killed her. Even then, Marla bore him no hatred. Novice Elreth remembers her final wish: to rest beside Samuel in the Deathknell graveyard.

Novice Elreth sends you northeast of Deathknell to find Samuel Fipps, who still wanders among a ruined campsite. Ending his torment would remove a Scourge minion from the valley and let his remains be carried back to Marla's resting place. Elreth believes that honoring the dead and their final wishes sets the newly freed Forsaken apart from the Scourge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.
Marla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband. So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.
Samuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell. Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We must respect our dead, friend. It is one of the ways in which we differ from the Scourge...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done a good deed today, friend. Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place.
